title: Recitation self-assessment rubric
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
source: Written for quran/y9 lesson 48 (Pupil PDF worksheet: self-assessment rubric)
intro: Lesson 48: Revision with the tajweed rubric: Al-Qiyamah and Al-Insan. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

arabic.text: لَآ أُقْسِمُ بِيَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ (١) وَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِٱلنَّفْسِ ٱللَّوَّامَةِ (٢) أَيَحْسَبُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ أَلَّن نَّجْمَعَ عِظَامَهُۥ (٣) بَلَىٰ قَٰدِرِينَ عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّسَوِّىَ بَنَانَهُۥ (٤) بَلْ يُرِيدُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ لِيَفْجُرَ أَمَامَهُۥ (٥) يَسْـَٔلُ أَيَّانَ يَوْمُ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ (٦) فَإِذَا بَرِقَ ٱلْبَصَرُ (٧) وَخَسَفَ ٱلْقَمَرُ (٨) وَجُمِعَ ٱلشَّمْسُ وَٱلْقَمَرُ (٩) يَقُولُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ يَوْمَئِذٍ أَيْنَ ٱلْمَفَرُّ (١٠)

questions.q: The teacher plays a short recitation of their own with two deliberate slips; mark it with the rubric.
questions.a: Slips found: e.g. missing ghunnah on «إِنَّا», short muttasil.

questions.q: Self-assessment (portal): record 76:1 to 10 at your desk, mark it, set two targets. Today's rota group recites Al-Qiyamah to the teacher.
questions.a: Recording uploaded; rubric and targets entered.

questions.q: Extend: re-record the weakest ayah after practice.

options: the word, the rule and the fix
questions.a: A) the word, the rule and the fix. Exact targets work.

questions.q: Think again: Can you hear your own mistakes while reciting? Why might a recording help?
questions.a: It is hard to listen while reciting; a recording lets you hear clearly afterwards (recorded at home for the teacher only).
